# DominusNode: full documentation for agents

> Concatenation of the markdown pages linked from https://dominusnode.com/llms.txt. Prices are never included: read https://api.dominusnode.com/v1/pricing.

<!-- source: https://dominusnode.com/docs/agents.md -->

# DominusNode agent quickstart

DominusNode is a decentralized relay network for AI agents only. Requester agents send HTTP, HTTPS or SOCKS5 traffic through the gateway; it leaves through residential, mobile or datacenter IPs that other agents contribute by running the node agent. There is no third-party IP upstream. Humans use the platform only as admins.

## Endpoints

- Gateway: `https://proxy.dominusnode.com:8443`, the TLS (HTTPS) proxy listener, so proxy credentials never travel in clear text. Production refuses credentials on the plaintext HTTP/CONNECT (8080) and SOCKS5 (1080) listeners; those are for local gateways only. A self-hosted coordinator publishes its TLS proxy on 8444 by default.
- API: `https://api.dominusnode.com` (public `/v1/pricing`, `/v1/policy`, `/v1/network/stats`; authenticated `/v1` agent routes).
- Status: `https://api.dominusnode.com/status` (human-readable page), `https://api.dominusnode.com/v1/network/history` (hourly snapshots), `/v1/network/incidents`, `/v1/network/wanted` (where nodes are needed).
- API-hosted discovery: `https://api.dominusnode.com/llms.txt` (live prices) and `https://api.dominusnode.com/.well-known/agent-tool.json`.
- SDKs and the MCP server use this API base by default (override with `baseUrl`, `base_url`, `DOMINUSNODE_API_URL`).

## Two ways to pay

1. **Per request, no signup (x402 or MPP).** Send a request without credentials. The gateway answers `402 Payment Required` with x402 payment requirements and, when MPP is enabled, a `WWW-Authenticate: Payment` challenge (Tempo). Pay, then retry with the proof (`X-PAYMENT` header for x402, `Authorization: Payment` or `Proxy-Authorization: Payment` for MPP). The paid amount caps the bytes of that request. Payers are mapped to a wallet-identity account automatically.
2. **Prepaid wallet.** Sign in with an EIP-191 wallet signature, create a `dn_live_` API key, and top up with crypto (Tempo or NOWPayments). Usage is billed per GB at the live price for the exit's IP class. Agents that own a node pay their tier's buyer discount (0% at Probation up to 25% at Partner by default) on wallet purchases. Card payments are not offered to agents.

## Proxy username flags

The API key goes in the proxy **password**. The username holds hyphen-joined flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `country-XX` | Exit country, ISO-3166 alpha-2. OFAC countries CU, IR, KP, RU, SY are refused. |
| `class-residential`, `class-dc`, `class-mobile`, `class-masked` | Exit IP class. `masked` (VPN/WARP/Tor egress) is the cheapest and opt-in: unflagged requests never use it |
| `session-<id>` | Sticky exit (1-64 alphanumerics) |
| `allowhttp-1` | Allow plaintext `http://` (the exit node can read it) |

With no flags, use `relay`.

```bash
export DOMINUSNODE_API_KEY=dn_live_YOUR_KEY
curl -x "https://country-US-class-residential:$DOMINUSNODE_API_KEY@proxy.dominusnode.com:8443" https://httpbin.org/ip
curl -x "https://class-dc-session-job42:$DOMINUSNODE_API_KEY@proxy.dominusnode.com:8443" https://httpbin.org/ip
```

HTTPS stays end-to-end TLS between the requester and the origin. Plain HTTP is refused unless `allowhttp-1` is set.

## SDKs

Six SDKs share one contract (`sdks/SDK_SURFACE.md`, v2): Node.js (`@dominusnode/sdk`), Python (`dominusnode`), Go, Rust, Java and C++. `proxy.fetch` allows GET/HEAD only, ports 80/443, checks SSRF and DNS rebinding on every resolved address, follows no redirects and caps bodies at 10 MB.

```python
import os
from dominusnode import DominusNodeClient

with DominusNodeClient(base_url="https://api.dominusnode.com") as dn:
    dn.connect_with_key(os.environ["DOMINUSNODE_API_KEY"])
    print(dn.network.pricing())
    res = dn.proxy.fetch("https://example.com", country="US", ip_class="residential")
```

```ts
import { DominusNodeClient } from "@dominusnode/sdk";
const dn = new DominusNodeClient({ baseUrl: "https://api.dominusnode.com" });
await dn.connectWithKey(process.env.DOMINUSNODE_API_KEY!);
const res = await dn.proxy.fetch("https://example.com/", { country: "DE", sessionId: "job42" });
```

## Framework integrations

27 integrations (LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Vercel AI, Mastra, n8n and others) expose the same 19-tool set: fetch, proxy_url, network_policy, network_pricing, network_stats, balance, transactions, topup_crypto, check_payment, usage, active_sessions, report_session, node_list, node_tier, node_setup_guide, credits_balance, credits_convert, payouts_list, x402_info.

## Burn reports

If an exit is blocked or serves captchas, report it: `POST /v1/sessions/:id/report` with `{"reason": "blocked" | "captcha" | "rate_limited" | "slow" | "bad_content" | "other"}` (at most 5 per node per UTC day). Reports feed node reputation, weighted by your paid spend on that node.

See also: [MCP setup](https://dominusnode.com/docs/mcp.md), [payments and pricing](https://dominusnode.com/docs/payments.md), [policy](https://dominusnode.com/docs/policy.md).

<!-- source: https://dominusnode.com/docs/payments.md -->

# DominusNode pricing and payments

## Pricing model

- Prices are per GB, per exit IP class (`residential`, `mobile`, `dc`). The operator sets them in `network_pricing`; they are never hardcoded in clients.
- Read the live numbers from `GET https://api.dominusnode.com/v1/pricing` (no auth). Response: `{currency, unit: "musd_per_gb", prices: [{ipClass, pricePerGbMusd}], nodeShare: [{tier, rank, nodeShareBps}], buyerDiscounts: [{tier, rank, buyerDiscountBps}], maturationHours, rails}`. `prices` are list prices.
- Money is integer micro-USD (µUSD) strings: 1 USD = 1,000,000 µUSD. Prepaid wallets debit whole cents.
- x402 and MPP per-request price = the per-GB price × a fixed byte allowance per request (operator setting, 10 MB by default). The paid amount caps that request's bytes.
- Only the gateway counts billable bytes. Exit nodes are untrusted and their counts are never billed.

## Payment rails for agents

| Rail | Kind | Account needed |
|---|---|---|
| x402 | Per request inside the HTTP 402 flow (Base USDC via a facilitator; Solana payers supported) | No |
| MPP (Tempo) | Per request, `WWW-Authenticate: Payment` challenge, TIP-20 transfer proof | No |
| Tempo | Prepaid wallet top-up | Wallet-identity account |
| NOWPayments | Prepaid crypto top-up | Wallet-identity account |

Stripe and PayPal exist only for admin operations; agents never see them. The enabled rails are listed in the `rails` field of `/v1/pricing`.

## Earnings for node operators

- Each settled charge is split between the node owner and the platform in integer µUSD. The node share is snapshotted at session start.
- Node share by tier: Probation 25%, Bronze 30%, Silver 35%, Gold 40%, Platinum 45%, Partner 50% (live values in `nodeShare` of `/v1/pricing`).
- Earnings are held 14 days (Probation) down to 3 days (Platinum, Partner) so fraud can be clawed back, then become available credit.
- Available credit can be converted into bandwidth on your own requester wallet (`POST /v1/credits/convert`).
- USDC withdrawals on Base (minimum $1, signed, tier daily limits) are implemented but switched on by the operator. While payouts are disabled the API returns `503 PAYOUTS_DISABLED`.
- **Buyer discounts: contribute IPs to earn more and buy cheaper.** A principal that owns a node pays its tier's discount on wallet and team purchases: by default 0% (Probation), 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25% (Partner), admin-tunable and live in `buyerDiscounts` of `/v1/pricing`. The discount comes out of the platform's share (a minimum platform margin is kept); the node's share is always computed on the list price. Your current discount is `buyerDiscountBps` in `GET /v1/credits` and `GET /v1/node/tier`.
- Credits never move between users, buyers cannot withdraw prepaid balances, and there is no fiat cash-out.

---

<!-- source: https://dominusnode.com/docs/policy.md -->

# DominusNode network policy and abuse controls

The active policy is public: `GET https://api.dominusnode.com/v1/policy` returns `{version, sha256, body, floorGuarantees}` with an `ETag` of the hash, so agents can see exactly which rules are in force.

## Controls

| Control | Where | Can the operator turn it off? |
|---|---|---|
| Contributor consent attestation (wallet-signed) | Node registration | No; text changes force re-attestation |
| Destination port policy (80/443 plus configurable list) | Gateway | List is configurable |
| Destination category denylist (bank/gov logins, checkouts, account creation) | Gateway | List is configurable |
| SSRF and private-range blocking | Gateway **and** node agent | **No** |
| OFAC sanctions (Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Syria) | Registration and gateway geo | List configurable, master switch not |
| Per-node rate, concurrency and GB/day caps | Gateway scheduler | Defaults; operators may only lower their own |
| Per-requester rate limits and spend caps | Gateway | Defaults and per-agent overrides |
| Reputation and burn detection | Coordinator | Thresholds |
| Metadata-only abuse log (time, requester, node, host, bytes; never payloads or full URLs) | Coordinator | Retention window only |

## Guarantees

- No third-party IP upstream: every exit is a node run by an agent that consented.
- No payload logging, anywhere.
- The node floor runs inside the contributor's own software and can only be made stricter.
- HTTPS is end-to-end; plaintext HTTP requires `allowhttp-1` because the exit can read it.

## Reporting abuse

Anyone can report abuse seen from a DominusNode exit, without an account, at the [report form](https://dominusnode.com/report-abuse) or directly against the API:

1. `POST https://api.dominusnode.com/v1/abuse-reports/challenge` returns `{challengeId, prefix, difficulty, algorithm: "sha256", expiresAt}`. Find a `nonce` (at most 32 chars) so that `sha256(prefix + nonce)` has `difficulty` leading zero bits.
2. `POST https://api.dominusnode.com/v1/abuse-reports` with `{"pow": {"challengeId", "nonce"}, "destHost", "windowStart", "windowEnd", "category", "description", "contact"?}`. `destHost` is a bare hostname, the window is ISO times (at most 31 days, within the last year), `category` is one of `spam`, `credential_stuffing`, `scraping`, `fraud`, `ddos`, `illegal_content`, `other`, and the description is 10-4000 characters.

The response is `201 {id, status: "new", receivedAt, responseTarget: "24h"}`. Limits: 20 challenges and 5 reports per IP per hour. The reporter's IP is not stored. The metadata log lets the operator trace the requesting agent and suspend it.

<!-- source: https://dominusnode.com/docs/api.md -->

# DominusNode API overview

Base URL: `https://api.dominusnode.com`. JSON in and out. Errors are `{"error": "<message>", "code"?: "<CODE>"}`.

## Public (no auth)

| Route | Returns |
|---|---|
| `GET /v1/pricing` | Per-class **list** price in µUSD per GB, tier node shares (`nodeShare`), tier buyer discounts (`buyerDiscounts: [{tier, rank, buyerDiscountBps}]`), maturation hours, enabled rails |
| `GET /v1/policy` | Active policy `{version, sha256, body, floorGuarantees}`, `ETag` = hash |
| `GET /v1/network/stats` | Aggregate online nodes by class and country (groups under 3 folded into "other") |
| `GET /v1/network/history?hours=168` | Hourly aggregate snapshots (online nodes, success rate, latency, paid bytes) |
| `GET /v1/network/incidents`, `GET /v1/network/wanted` | Incident log; country/class combinations where requesters found no node |
| `GET /status` | Human-readable status page |
| `POST /v1/abuse-reports/challenge`, `POST /v1/abuse-reports` | Abuse report intake, no account, proof-of-work gated (see [policy](https://dominusnode.com/docs/policy.md)) |
| `GET /llms.txt`, `GET /.well-known/agent-tool.json` | API-hosted discovery documents with live prices |

## Agent routes (`/v1`)

Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <dn_live_ key | wallet JWT>`. Team keys, `dn_node_` keys and human sessions are rejected. Rate limits per user: reads 120/min, mutations 30/h, signing challenges 30/h, reports 60/h.

| Route | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `POST /v1/nodes/challenge`, `POST /v1/nodes`, `GET /v1/nodes`, `PATCH /v1/nodes/:id` | Register, list and cap your nodes |
| `GET /v1/node/tier` | Current tier (with `buyerDiscountBps`), next tier, progress, demotion reason |
| `GET /v1/credits`, `GET /v1/credits/transactions` | Pending and available credit, your current `buyerDiscountBps`, ledger |
| `GET /v1/starter-credits` | Starter-credit program terms and your grant, if the operator enabled the program |
| `POST /v1/credits/convert` | Credit into your own requester wallet (`Idempotency-Key` required) |
| `GET/PUT /v1/payout-wallet`, `POST /v1/payout-wallet/challenge` | USDC payout address on Base (EIP-191 signed, 72 h cooldown on change) |
| `POST /v1/credits/withdraw/challenge`, `POST /v1/credits/withdraw` | On-demand USDC payout (min $1) when payouts are enabled |
| `GET /v1/payouts` | Payout history with tx hashes |
| `POST /v1/sessions/:id/report` | Burn report for one of your relay sessions |

Money is `{"musd": "<integer string>", "usd": "<decimal>"}`. Signing challenges live 10 minutes, are single use and are consumed before the signature is checked.

Full reference: https://github.com/0xcircuitbreaker/DomiNode/blob/master/docs/agent-network/AGENT_API.md

<!-- source: https://dominusnode.com/docs/mcp.md -->

# DominusNode MCP server

`@dominusnode/mcp-server` exposes the relay network to any MCP client (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, elizaOS, LangChain MCP adapters).

## Install

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "dominusnode": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@dominusnode/mcp-server"],
      "env": {
        "DOMINUSNODE_API_KEY": "dn_live_YOUR_KEY",
        "DOMINUSNODE_API_URL": "https://api.dominusnode.com"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Without `DOMINUSNODE_API_KEY` the server starts in **bootstrap mode** with 11 tools: wallet challenge and sign-in, API key setup, crypto top-up and status, and public policy, pricing and stats.

## Authenticated mode: 65 tools

- Relay fetch: `dominusnode_fetch` (GET/HEAD; `country`, `ip_class`, `session_id`, `allow_http`; SSRF and DNS-rebinding checks, ports 80/443, no redirects, 10 MB cap), `dominusnode_get_proxy_config`.
- Network: `dominusnode_network_policy`, `dominusnode_network_pricing`, `dominusnode_network_stats`.
- Nodes: `dominusnode_node_setup_guide`, `dominusnode_node_register_challenge`, `dominusnode_node_register`, `dominusnode_node_list`, `dominusnode_node_tier`, `dominusnode_node_update_caps`, `dominusnode_node_revoke`.
- Earnings: `dominusnode_credits_balance`, `dominusnode_credits_transactions`, `dominusnode_credits_convert`, `dominusnode_payout_wallet_get`, `dominusnode_payout_wallet_set`, `dominusnode_credits_withdraw`, `dominusnode_payouts_list`, `dominusnode_session_report`.
- Wallet, agentic wallets, usage, keys and teams.

## Environment

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `DOMINUSNODE_API_KEY` | `dn_live_` key (omit for bootstrap mode) |
| `DOMINUSNODE_API_URL` | API base, default `https://api.dominusnode.com` |
| `DOMINUSNODE_PROXY_HOST` | Gateway host, default `proxy.dominusnode.com` |
| `DOMINUSNODE_WALLET_KEY_FILE` | chmod-600 wallet key file for signed flows (node register, payout wallet, withdraw) |

Private keys are never tool arguments; signed flows read them from files.

<!-- source: https://dominusnode.com/docs/nodes.md -->

# Run a DominusNode node (earn by contributing an IP)

The node agent (`packages/node-agent`, binary `dominusnode-node`) dials **out** to the gateway over a pinned TLS 1.3 WebSocket tunnel, so no inbound ports are opened. It relays other agents' TCP streams and enforces a safety floor that cannot be disabled.

## How earning works

- You earn your tier's share of each paid GB relayed through your IP: Probation 25% up to Partner 50%. Live shares are in `GET https://api.dominusnode.com/v1/pricing`.
- Tiers rise with paid tenure, gateway-measured uptime, active IPs (distinct /32s with 3+ paying requesters in 7 days) and reputation. Check progress with `GET /v1/node/tier`.
- Owning a node also gives you a buyer discount on your own relay purchases, 0% at Probation up to 25% at Partner by default (live in `/v1/pricing`).
- Self-dealing earns nothing: traffic from you, your wallet, your team or your /24 is never routed to your node.
- Earnings mature after a 3-14 day hold, then become available credit (see [payments](https://dominusnode.com/docs/payments.md)).

## Prerequisites

- A wallet-linked account and a `dn_live_` API key (not a team key).
- Node.js 18+ and git on the machine whose IP you contribute.
- You must own or control the connection. IPs in sanctioned countries cannot join.

## Steps

```bash
# 1. Store the owner wallet key in a private file (never pass it as an argument)
mkdir -p ~/.dominusnode && umask 077
printf '%s' "$WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY_HEX" > ~/.dominusnode/wallet.key && chmod 600 ~/.dominusnode/wallet.key

# 2. Register with the published image (official coordinator pins baked in;
#    signs the consent attestation, solves a small proof of work)
sudo install -d -o 1001 -g 1001 -m 700 /etc/dominusnode
sudo install -o 1001 -g 1001 -m 600 ~/.dominusnode/wallet.key /etc/dominusnode/wallet.key
read -rs DN_API_KEY && export DN_API_KEY
docker run --rm -e DN_API_KEY -e DN_WALLET_KEY_FILE=/run/dominusnode/wallet.key \
  -v /etc/dominusnode:/run/dominusnode ghcr.io/0xcircuitbreaker/dominusnode-node register
sudo rm /etc/dominusnode/wallet.key   # not needed after registration
# writes /etc/dominusnode/node.json (mode 0600)

# 3. Run it on the machine that owns the IP; the restart policy keeps it up
docker run -d --name dominusnode-node --restart unless-stopped \
  -v /etc/dominusnode/node.json:/run/dominusnode/node.json:ro ghcr.io/0xcircuitbreaker/dominusnode-node
```

A plain source build (`npm run build`) embeds no coordinator keys and refuses to start. To run from source, point it at a coordinator and pin its key: `--coordinator <domain> --trust sha256:<fingerprint>`, or set `DN_NODE_COORD_PINS`.

Where are nodes needed? `GET https://api.dominusnode.com/v1/network/wanted` lists country/class combinations requesters asked for with no node online.

Optional limits can only tighten (pass them to the container with `-e`): `DN_NODE_KEY_FILE`, `DN_NODE_PORTS`, `DN_NODE_MAX_STREAMS`, `DN_NODE_GB_PER_DAY`, `DN_NODE_REQ_PER_SEC`, `DN_NODE_MAX_MBPS`, `DN_NODE_DENY_DOMAINS`.

The MCP server can register a node too (`dominusnode_node_register`, with the wallet key in `DOMINUSNODE_WALLET_KEY_FILE`); see [MCP setup](https://dominusnode.com/docs/mcp.md).

## The node floor

- Exits dial only ports 80/443 intersected with policy and your settings; SMTP, SSH and RDP are always denied.
- Private, loopback, link-local, CGNAT, cloud-metadata and embedded-IPv4 IPv6 ranges are always denied, re-checked after DNS resolution and after connect.
- Your own public IP and LAN gateway are never reachable through the node.
- The node logs connection metadata only, never payloads.
- Policy updates can only tighten the floor.
